summary: Frontend E2E for the new Teya-inspired homepage and /jak-pracuji page. Verified all testids exist (hero, card-intro, gold-intro, bento 9 cards, app-section, testimonials, calculators), hero scroll overlay, bento micro-animations (cashflow-stack changes, invest-form toggles to 'Investice nastavena', funding-mock counts up to 4 800 000 Kč), expand dialog with /kontakt CTA and Escape close, navbar/Služby dropdown hrefs, VI language switch (all expected VI texts render, no 'undefined'), /jak-pracuji renders and hash scroll for #system and #majetek works, sections correctly removed from '/'. Backend /api/health = 200 and POST /api/leads creates lead (201). No console errors on '/' or '/jak-pracuji'.

ui_bugs.issue: Video element is unmounted on onError (conditional render), so [data-testid="hero-video"] disappears from DOM if src fails / codec unsupported (headless). Spec requires the element to exist with src /videos/hero.mp4 regardless of playback. Keep <video> mounted (hidden via opacity) even after failure so the testid remains queryable.

card-intro-left/right opacity at the middle of the 200vh sticky section is only ~0.63–0.67 instead of ~1. Animation range likely maps 0.35→1 with 1 hit only near the end of the section, not middle. Consider shifting useScrollMap so opacity reaches 1 around scrollYProgress ~0.5.

issues: Hero script headline overflows the viewport horizontally: SPAN.font-script has right=404px (>390). The clamp(40px,5vw,84px) minimum of 40px + 'jednoduše.' width pushes past 390. Consider clamp(28px, 8vw, 84px) or px-4 wrapper for the hero title on mobile.

Horizontal snap-scroll container children (DIV.w-[220px] shrink-0 snap-start) report right=456px. Only a bug if this scroller is not intentionally horizontal; if intentional (mobile card carousel), please ensure the parent has overflow-x: auto so it does not create page-wide horizontal scroll. Body scrollWidth should equal innerWidth.

action_items: Keep <video data-testid="hero-video"> mounted even when onError fires (so the DOM node/testid stays reachable per spec).
Adjust CardIntro useScrollMap so opacity of card-intro-left/right reaches ~1 at scroll midpoint of the 200vh section.
Fix hero title overflow on 390px viewport (reduce clamp min or add horizontal padding).
Verify /jak-pracuji horizontal scroller on mobile is contained (parent overflow-x-auto, no body-level horizontal overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero video conditional render tied to a single-shot error state removes the element permanently; better UX/testability is to always render <video> and only hide it with CSS while playing the image fallback.
useScrollMap ranges in CardIntro drift the reveal past the sticky midpoint; consider anchoring to sticky center to match Teya-like feel.
Mobile hero typography uses viewport-relative clamp without a wrapper padding, causing overflow at 390px. Add px-4/overflow-hidden on the hero container.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all testids/anim/VI/nav pass; 1 real mobile overflow + 2 minor UX/testability issues)

rca of the issue: Mobile hero overflow: hero-title uses text-[clamp(40px,5vw,84px)] font-script (italic, wide glyph). At 390px viewport the minimum 40px font-size for 'jednoduše.' renders ~404px wide, exceeding viewport. Fix: reduce clamp min (~28-32px) or wrap in a container with px-4 + overflow-hidden.
